name: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Vasatigruh Nirvah Bhatta Yojna.
description: This is a plan for students of government, government funded and non-affiliated colleges / polytechnics entering the vocational courses set by the government, whose students are certified by the competent authority, as a marginal farmers or whose parents are registered laborers.
department: Maharashtra Animal and Fishery Sciences University(MAFSU)
implementingAuthority: Maharashtra Animal and Fishery Sciences University(MAFSU)

criteria.label: a). Applicant should have Nationality of India.

evidence.quote: a). Applicant should have Nationality of India.
b). Candidate should be Domicile of Maharashtra State.

criteria.label: c). Applicant should be ”Bonafide Student of Institute” and admitted for Professional and Technical course (Graduation / Post Graduation Degree) as mentioned in GR.

evidence.quote: c). Applicant should be ”Bonafide Student of Institute” and admitted for Professional and Technical course (Graduation / Post Graduation Degree) as mentioned in GR.

criteria.label: d). Deemed University and Private university is not applicable.

evidence.quote: d). Deemed University and Private university is not applicable.

criteria.label: e). Candidate should be admitted through Centralized Admission Process (CAP).

evidence.quote: e). Candidate should be admitted through Centralized Admission Process (CAP).

criteria.label: f). Applicant should not avail any other Maintenance Allowance Scheme.

evidence.quote: f). Applicant should not avail any other Maintenance Allowance Scheme.

criteria.label: g). For current Academic Year, Only 2 child from family are allowed for benefit of scheme.

evidence.quote: g). For current Academic Year, Only 2 child from family are allowed for benefit of scheme.

criteria.label: h). Applicant should be child of Registered Labour or Child of Alpabhudharak or Both / Total Annual Income of Family / Guardian should not be more than 6 Lakhs.

evidence.quote: h). Applicant should be child of Registered Labour or Child of Alpabhudharak or Both / Total Annual Income of Family / Guardian should not be more than 6 Lakhs.

criteria.label: i). Minimum 50 % attendance in previous semester (Exception for fresh admitted in College).

evidence.quote: i). Minimum 50 % attendance in previous semester (Exception for fresh admitted in College).

criteria.label: j). During course duration, candidate should not have a gap of 2 years.

evidence.quote: j). During course duration, candidate should not have a gap of 2 years.
k). Applicant should be Hosteller.

criteria.label: l). Should not avail maintenance allowance of any other scheme.

evidence.quote: l). Should not avail maintenance allowance of any other scheme.

criteria.label: m). Candidates are eligible those who have taken an admission under general category.

evidence.quote: m). Candidates are eligible those who have taken an admission under general category.

criteria.label: n). Applicant should attempt every semester or annual exam.

evidence.quote: n). Applicant should attempt every semester or annual exam.
